Hi Elaine — great to meet you virtually. Quick note on the timing: the US daylight saving time ends on Sun Nov 1 this year, which will shift Pacific times back one hour. That means your Nov 3 11:00 AM PT proposal maps to Nov 4 3:00 AM AEDT for Sydney attendees if we keep the same wall-clock times.

Two options that usually work well for multi-region demos:
1) Run a single cross-region session in the late US evening (example: Nov 4, 8:00 PM PT / Nov 5, 4:00 PM AEDT) — that keeps it within regular hours for APAC and is after US working hours.
2) Host two shorter regional sessions (30 minutes each) — a US-friendly live demo and a recorded/short Q&A for APAC at a more reasonable hour.

I've attached a quick mutual action plan and will propose a couple of calendar slots. If you prefer option 1, I'll send a single invite that accounts for the DST change. If option 2, Marissa can coordinate the second slot.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, redwood-demo-ics.ics (calendar stub)

Best,
Sooyoung (Soojin) Lee
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
